scenarios.title_zh: ucp-schema#80 & #79：缺省字段 open/strict 校验矩阵与 lint --quiet --strict 退出码 1
scenarios.title_en: ucp-schema#80 & #79: Omitted-Field Open/Strict Matrix & lint --quiet --strict Exit Code 1
scenarios.question_zh: 当对象 Schema 省略 additionalProperties 时，strict 模式却放行未声明字段，或 lint --quiet --strict 在存在告警时返回退出码 0，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block strict validation that accepts undeclared fields on omitted additionalProperties or lint --quiet --strict returning exit code 0 on warnings?

scenarios.title_zh: ucp-schema#77：strict 模式覆写显式 allOf unevaluatedProperties: true 并保留 Map Schema
scenarios.title_en: ucp-schema#77: Closing Explicit allOf unevaluatedProperties: true in Strict Mode
scenarios.question_zh: 当 fulfillment_Request 等 allOf 组合 Schema 显式标注 unevaluatedProperties: true 时，strict 模式若未将其覆写为 false 导致未知根字段逃逸，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block strict-mode resolution that fails to overwrite explicit unevaluatedProperties: true to false on allOf composition schemas?

scenarios.title_zh: ucp-schema#75 & #74：/2026-04-08/schemas/ 版本化 $id URL 与 --schema 默认请求方向
scenarios.title_en: ucp-schema#75 & #74: Versioned /2026-04-08/schemas/ URLs & Default Request Direction
scenarios.question_zh: 当 Schema $id 或能力 URL 缺少版本段 /2026-04-08/，或单独传入 --schema 未默认按 request 方向解析时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block unversioned https://ucp.dev/schemas/... URLs or --schema invocations that fail to default to request direction?

scenarios.title_zh: ucp-schema#73：5 遍 OpenAPI 3.1.0 编译器（版本一致、方向极化组件、不可达 Schema 剪枝）
scenarios.title_en: ucp-schema#73: 5-Pass OpenAPI 3.1.0 Compiler (Version Check, Polarized Schemas & Pruning)
scenarios.question_zh: 当 export-openapi 合并不同 x-ucp-version 规范、残留 ucp_* 注解/外部文件 $ref 或未剪枝不可达组件 Schema 时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block OpenAPI exports with mismatched x-ucp-version, leaked ucp_* annotations, unrewritten file $refs, or unpruned unreachable schemas?

scenarios.title_zh: js-sdk#87：ucp-schema Zod 代码生成迁移与开放联合类型 not.enum / <Union>Base 防遮蔽
scenarios.title_en: js-sdk#87: ucp-schema Zod Codegen & Open-Union not.enum / <Union>Base Shadowing Guard
scenarios.question_zh: 当开放联合类型的自定义字符串分支未生成 not.enum refine 或被纳入 <Union>Base 导致下游扩展分支被遮蔽时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block open-union Zod schemas that omit not.enum refinement or include bare string catchalls in <Union>Base, shadowing extension branches?

scenarios.title_zh: js-sdk#84：71 个开放 Zod 对象 Schema 附加 .catchall(z.any()) 保留 credential.token
scenarios.title_en: js-sdk#84: .catchall(z.any()) on 71 Open Zod Object Schemas Preserving credential.token
scenarios.question_zh: 当 Zod 默认 .strip() 静默剥离 PaymentCredentialSchema 子类型字段 payment.instruments[0].credential.token 时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block Zod open object schemas that omit .catchall(z.any()) and silently strip subtype fields like credential.token?

scenarios.title_zh: js-sdk#83：无约束 {id, type} 桩降权防 BindingSchema 反向域名正则污染 FulfillmentDestination
scenarios.title_en: js-sdk#83: Unconstrained {id, type} Penalty Preventing BindingSchema Leakage into FulfillmentDestination
scenarios.question_zh: 当 BindingSchema 混入 FulfillmentDestinationSchema 导致邮编类型错误被报为反向域名正则失败时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block FulfillmentDestinationSchema unions that include BindingSchema and mask address errors behind reverse-domain regex failures?

scenarios.title_zh: js-sdk#80, #79, #73：非空转 dependentRequired superRefine、分操作履约请求与发现 Profile services
scenarios.title_en: js-sdk#80, #79, #73: Non-Vacuous dependentRequired, Per-Op Request Fulfillment & Discovery services
scenarios.question_zh: 当 TimeIntervalSchema 的 dependentRequired 退化为 || (true) 永真式，或 UcpDiscoveryProfileSchema.ucp 丢失 services 字段时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block vacuous || (true) dependentRequired refinements, collapsed request fulfillment unions, or discovery profiles missing ucp.services?

scenarios.title_zh: python-sdk#101：ucp-schema Pydantic 代码生成与 JwkPublicKey 严禁私钥字段 (d/p/q/dp/dq/qi/oth/k)

scenarios.question_zh: 当公开 /.well-known/ucp 的 JwkPublicKey 混入 RSA/EC 私钥参数 d、p、q 或对称密钥 k 而未被 Pydantic 拦截时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block JwkPublicKey models that fail to reject forbidden private-key parameters (d, p, q, dp, dq, qi, oth, k)?

scenarios.title_zh: python-sdk#100 & #99：AwareDatetime 剥离 Field(pattern=...) 移入 mode='before' 与 release.yml SHA 钉死
scenarios.title_en: python-sdk#100 & #99: AwareDatetime mode='before' Regex Validator & SHA-Pinned release.yml
scenarios.question_zh: 当 PurchaseOption.open_at 的 AwareDatetime 保留 Field(pattern=...) 导致合法时间戳抛 TypeError，或发布工作流未钉死 40 位 SHA 时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block AwareDatetime fields that retain post-parse Field(pattern=...) or release workflows with unpinned action tags?

scenarios.title_zh: python-sdk#97 & #96：单模块拓扑序 ucp_sdk/models.py 消除循环引用与 model_fields_set dependentRequired
scenarios.title_en: python-sdk#97 & #96: Single-Module Topological models.py & model_fields_set dependentRequired
scenarios.question_zh: 当递归模型因跨文件循环导入抛 PydanticUserError，或 TimeInterval 未基于 model_fields_set 校验 dependentRequired 时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block fragmented circular Pydantic modules that fail model_rebuild() or omit model_fields_set dependentRequired validation?

scenarios.title_zh: python-sdk#94：点分能力名 dev.ucp.shopping.checkout 四角色容器拆分防覆盖
scenarios.question_zh: 当 dev.ucp.shopping.checkout 的四个角色容器（platform_schema、business_schema、response_checkout_schema、response_order_schema）因末段同名互相覆盖时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block codegen that collides dotted capability names across platform, business, checkout-response, and order-response role containers?

scenarios.title_zh: conformance#111：结账生命周期 400 <= status < 500 状态码段与移除 409 缺货创建逃生门
scenarios.title_en: conformance#111: Checkout Lifecycle 400 <= status < 500 Band & Removal of 409 Stock Escape Hatch
scenarios.question_zh: 当缺货商品在 create_checkout 阶段借旧版 != 409 逃生门返回 200 OK，或篡改已完成结账未返回 4xx 时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block checkout lifecycle tests that allow 200 OK on out-of-stock creation or fail to enforce 400 <= status < 500 on completed checkouts?

scenarios.title_zh: conformance#109：shopping-agent-test.json 完整声明被测购物能力防交集裁剪
scenarios.title_en: conformance#109: Declaring All Exercised Capabilities in shopping-agent-test.json
scenarios.question_zh: 当测试 Agent Profile 仅声明 checkout 而遗漏 fulfillment、discount、buyer_consent 导致商户按规范裁剪扩展字段时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block conformance agent profiles that omit exercised capabilities (fulfillment, discount, buyer_consent) and trigger capability pruning?

scenarios.title_zh: conformance#98：test_discovery_urls 严格 HTTP 200 可达性核验与 allow_unreachable_urls 夹具白名单
scenarios.title_en: conformance#98: Strict test_discovery_urls Reachability with allow_unreachable_urls Allowlist
scenarios.question_zh: 当 /.well-known/ucp 宣告的 Schema 或服务端点 URL 返回 404 且不在负向测试夹具 allow_unreachable_urls 白名单中时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block unreachable /.well-known/ucp schema or service URLs unless explicitly listed in the fixture's allow_unreachable_urls?

scenarios.title_zh: conformance#97：ShippingDestination 邮政地址规范字段名 address_locality 与 address_region
scenarios.title_en: conformance#97: Canonical PostalAddress Fields address_locality & address_region
scenarios.question_zh: 当一致性测试在 ShippingDestination 中发送非规范字段 locality / administrative_area 而非 address_locality / address_region 时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Block ShippingDestination payloads using legacy locality/administrative_area instead of canonical address_locality/address_region?
